org.orgName: Monastery of Saint John the Evangelist
org.note: Colophon 1 dates the Gospel to Armenian era 548 (1099 CE). In the concluding passage (fol. 280r, col. B), the scribe records that it was completed in Alexandria, under the shadow of Saint John the Evangelist.
The formula ընդ հովանե[ա]ւ Յովհաննու աւետարանչին indicates monastic patronage in this context.
The monastery's name is supplied editorially from the invocation of the saint. Its location in Alexandria is inferred from the stated place of completion of the Gospel.
